profile.headline: Software Engineer at AMD. BS & MS degree in Computer Science and Engineering at Santa Clara University.
profile.summary: Software engineer passionate about learning new technologies, with experience in front end development and software engineering, looking to gain a new position to leverage and expand my skill set.

positions.title: Front End Software Engineer
positions.description:
Created web applications based on client requirements and specifications using HTML, Typescript, CSS, and Angular.

Designed a database application to allow the storage and query of purchase orders using MongoDB.

company.name: BCE Heating Elements, Vacuum Feedthroughs & Thermal Systems

positions.title: Front End Software Engineer
positions.description:
Created web applications based on client requirements and specifications using HTML, Typescript, CSS, and Angular.

Designed a database application to allow the storage and query of purchase orders using MongoDB.

positions.title: Web Developer and Tester
positions.description:
Aided in the programming, testing, and deployment of a web-based technical graphing and spreadsheet application.

Tested the web application from a user perspective for functionality and ease of use. Documented all issues and provided feedback to the development team.

Improved cross browser compatibility and performance by identifying and repairing HTML, JavaScript, and CSS errors.

Developed and expanded features such as: statistical report generation, saving/printing graphs, and graph file saving.

positions.title: Computer Science Tutor
positions.description: Privately tutored a student attending University of California, Berkeley in computer science with topics such as Java, data structures, and algorithms.

positions.title: Front End Software Engineer
positions.description:
Created several responsive SPA web applications for customizing and designing BCE products using HTML/Pug, CSS/SCSS, JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, Express.js.

Led in the creation of customer facing and internal applications to increase productivity and efficiency of sales.

Developed Object Oriented applications to improve code reusability and efficiency using TypeScript.

Designed HTML email templates using Handlebars and Nodemailer for product request confirmation and details.

company.name: BCE Heating Elements, Vacuum Feedthroughs & Thermal Systems

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Ran labs for Advanced Programming, Data Structures, Object-Oriented Programming in C/C++ for 60 undergraduate students.

Taught students how to develop and be familiar in a UNIX/Linux environment with a command line.

Clarified complex concepts to help students succeed in computer programing and provided additional support to students in office hours, lab, and over email.

Collaborated with colleagues and professors to optimize the teaching process.

Debugged student programs and helped students understand and learn from their mistakes.

Guided students on best practices (readable and well-documented code) for C/C++ assignments.

positions.title: Application Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Ran test patterns to measure output from jet dispensers to ensure it met customer specification and reported results to aid in the development of product.

Improved product performance by researching variables that impacted jet nozzle and diaphragm pairs such as timing, heating, and pressure.

volunteerExperiences.companyName: Santa Clara University's Vietnamese Student Association
volunteerExperiences.description: Founded in 1982, SCU VSA’s mission is to promote awareness of, appreciation of, and participation in Vietnamese culture and the local Vietnamese community, as well as provide representation and support for current and prospective Vietnamese students on campus. As a resident club of the Multicultural Center, our advocacy also extends to students of all backgrounds, especially the most marginalized.

company.name: Santa Clara University's Vietnamese Student Association

projects.title: Mini Golf “Game” Robot​
projects.description: Integrated IR sensors, line sensors, accelerometers, and other sensors to an Arduino platform to develop a robot that plays a custom “mini golf” track that putts golf balls through hills, zigzags, and windmills aided with a PID controller algorithm.

projects.title: Multi-bot Easy Control Hierarchy
projects.description: Collaborated with team members to develop a software architecture that controlled clusters of robot platforms which integrated switchable MATLAB controllers with the Java DataTurbine data engine and web-based GUI. Robots were programmed with Python and used the Pozyx positioning system for accurate indoor navigation.

publications.title: Multi-bot Easy Control Hierarchy
publications.publisher: Santa Clara : Santa Clara University, 2017. · Jun 15, 2017
